title: Madh e Zainab labon pe jaari hai
body:
Madh e Zainab labon pe jaari hai
Ayaton per khumar taari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Karke Zainab teri sana hum ne
Phir tahajjud mai shab guzari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis musalle pe aaye the Hasnain
Rab ne Zainab wahin utari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Sun ke khutba Ali bhi kehte hain
Meri har baat ab tumhari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Phir gaya hai yazeed ka chehra
Tum ne baiyat yun mun pe maari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud ko bole kaniz e Zainab wo
Jis ko parde ki pasdaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisi yeh hamd kirdgaari hai
Kat gaya sar namaz jaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Mit gaye fatwe aur fatwa farosh
Sheh ka matam abhi bhi jaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun banata hai mun tabarre per
Kiya teri un se rishtedaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab kiya mai ne matam e Shabbir
Maa ne meri nazar utari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Akber ka hai karam Bibi
Yeh jo ab tak azaan jaari hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae taqallum wo subh e qismat hai
Sham mai sham jo guzari hai
author: Mir Hassan Mir
